title: Phaung Daw U Pagoda

groundCutout.basis: The mapped visitor terrace bounds the replacement of radar returns from the shrine and arrival roofs.

buildingCutout.basis: Native sanctuary and attached covered dock hall, preserving adjoining independently mapped buildings.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation just north of the covered arrival hall, using the local landing datum.

mapIdentity.provider: Named native pagoda plan, connecting hall footprint, terrace and canal geometry.
mapIdentity.scope: The named outline anchors the pagoda about 234 m east of the initial story coordinate. The native attached hall, pedestrian terrace and canal centerline establish the limits of the arrival buildings, landing and waterfront.

note: The two exact Qualla originals show the gilded bell above red multi-tiered roofs, gold bargeboards and cresting, tall windowed and columned upper gallery, and the lower and taller tiers of the arrival pavilion. The contemporary national festival register and UNESCO establish the Inle Lake site.
